scope: Remote approval feedback frontend replay and native input verification

reused_evidence.observation: Feedback is a distinct callback. Trim whitespace/newlines. Empty button dispatches deny; empty keyboard submission is a no-op. Nonempty submission clears local text before forwarding.

independent_adapter: Existing request-scoped synthetic replay now handles feedback separately from approval/denial.
A valid feedback event resolves the synthetic pending request and starts a synthetic clarification response. No permission or command execution is granted.
Reject an empty feedback payload at the intent boundary. Preserve existing full-request comparison and duplicate resolution guard.
input_investigation: v547 manual input/revision rejection remains unproven.
Follow-up UI captures the draft at view rendering; ordinary send snapshots at action time. This is a local implementation observation, not a proven cause.

v548 r2 produced English prediction mishap for nihao. It failed before submission because the active native keyboard was English. Keyboard inventory contains Simplified Pinyin.
